Alger, 4 septembre 2026 (Algeria Tech) —: Algiers, September 4, 2026 (Algeria Tech) — The Minister of Energy and Renewable Energies, Mourad Adjal, chaired a meeting on Thursday of the Sectoral Coordination Commission dedicated to reviewing priority files related to off-grid solar energy, wind power, and energy cooperation with several African countries.
Lancement des projets solaires isolés et: Launch of isolated solar and wind projects
Le ministre de l’Énergie et des Énergies: The Minister of Energy and Renewable Energies, Mourad Adjal, chaired a meeting of the Sectoral Coordination Commission at his department's headquarters. This gathering, held in the presence of executives and central officials from the sector as well as senior managers from the Sonelgaz group, provided an opportunity to examine several priority files. These include the launch of construction and installation operations for isolated off-grid solar units, as well as wind farm projects.
Le communiqué du ministère précise que l: The ministry's press release specified that preparations for the off-grid solar units focused on identifying priority areas and sites to benefit from them, as well as ensuring optimal coordination between the concerned agencies, structures, and operators. A precise schedule was established for executing operations and monitoring the various stages in the field, with emphasis placed on the need for continuous monitoring until the units are commissioned.
S’agissant des centrales éoliennes, la r: Regarding wind power plants, the meeting reviewed the follow-up of technical studies related to the projects, the identification of eligible sites, and the completion of the technical and regulatory procedures necessary for their launch. Coordination among the various stakeholders was emphasized in order to accelerate the pace of construction.
Suivi des coopérations énergétiques avec: Monitoring energy cooperation with Chad, Benin, and Niger
La réunion a également abordé les dossie: The meeting also addressed energy cooperation files with several African countries. Regarding Chad, emphasis was placed on monitoring the progress of the project to build a power plant with a capacity of 40 megawatts in N'Djamena, particularly regarding technical and regulatory aspects.
Avec le Bénin, les discussions ont porté: With Benin, discussions focused on monitoring the implementation of commitments and agreements concluded between the two parties, as well as identifying priority areas of cooperation. The stated objective was to materialize the agreed-upon projects and programs.
Concernant le Niger, les échanges ont pe: Regarding Niger, the exchanges evaluated the progress of bilateral cooperation in the energy sector, particularly in Niamey and Agadez. Measures concerning the various files were examined with a view to strengthening coordination and continuing the realization of projects of common interest.
À l’issue de la réunion, le ministre a d: At the end of the meeting, the minister gave a series of instructions aimed at ensuring rigorous and efficient monitoring of the files on the agenda. He stressed the need to define priority measures, set precise and clear execution deadlines, and determine the responsibilities assigned to the various concerned structures. The strengthening of coordination between services, agencies, and operators was also highlighted.
Mourad Adjal a instruit de veiller au su: Mourad Adjal has instructed to ensure regular monitoring in the field of the various project completion stages and to set up an effective monitoring and evaluation mechanism. This includes the preparation of periodic reports on the progress status of projects, the elimination of recorded obstacles and the acceleration of the pace of fulfillment of commitments within the set deadlines.
Le ministre a insisté sur « l’importance: The minister emphasized "the importance of continuous monitoring and effective coordination between the various structures of the sector, in order to ensure the effective realization of projects and commitments and to strengthen energy cooperation with partner countries".
